External call to attacker-supplied spender contract via ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval before state finalization.

Completes ownership transfer if msg.sender equals newOwner.
onlyOwner setter for the newun gating address.

ERC20 approve; writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender.

Approves spender then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract (external call).
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of a given token holder.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
onlyOwner function that drains the contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
TokenERC20 constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply to owner and emits Transfer.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Payable fallback of MonkeyIsland that accepts ETH.
